item.title: Bhubaneswar–Dubai flight cancelled amid Middle East war situation
item.description: The Bhubaneswar-Dubai flight was cancelled on Monday in view of the prevailing war situation in the Middle East, airport authorities confirmed. The disruption follows airspace restrictions across several West Asian destinations. item.title: India’s basmati rice exports threatened by Middle East tensions
item.description: India’s rice exports are facing uncertainty as escalating military tensions in West Asia disrupt shipping and payments to key markets, including Iran, Afghanistan, and other Gulf countries. Exporters have raised concerns about delayed payments and stalled shipments, particularly for basmati rice, which accounts for nearly half of India’s exports to five West Asian nations — Saudi Arabia, Iran, Iraq, the UAE, and Yemen. item.title: Dalal Street rattled by Middle East conflict; Nifty, Sensex suffer big losses
item.description: Indian stock markets opened sharply lower on Monday as escalating military tensions in the Middle East rattled investor sentiment. The Nifty 50 fell 519.40 points, or 2.06 per cent, to 24,659.25, while the BSE Sensex dropped 2,775.14 points, or 3.41 per cent, to 78,512.05. The sell-off reflected heightened nervousness across domestic equities amid geopolitical uncertainty. item.title: Trailer hits statue of former minister Ghasiram Majhi in Nuapada; driver detained
item.description: Nuapada: A statue of former minister Ghasiram Majhi was damaged after a trailer allegedly lost control and collided with the monument at Ekta Chowk in Nuapada headquarters on Monday. According to reports, the speeding trailer struck the statue, causing it to fall and break into pieces. Visuals from the site showed the statue lying on the ground in a damaged condition, triggering anger among local residents. Police from Nuapada reached the spot soon after the incident.
